question: What support or replacement experiences do Samsung Galaxy S20 FE buyers describe?
answer:
One reviewer said they bought the S20 FE to replace their S9+ and found it easy to transfer all their apps and data to the new phone. [42e4f80a5f70_0]
That same reviewer said Samsung deliberately limits the performance of external SD cards to encourage people to buy phones with larger internal storage. [42e4f80a5f70_0]
That reviewer reported their SDXC card did 91MB/s read and 59MB/s write on their laptop's card reader but only 74MB/s read and 38MB/s write on the S20 FE. [42e4f80a5f70_0]
One reviewer described the S20 FE as a good renewed phone with no visible scratches that looks brand new. [cfe336b9e8d0_0]
One reviewer said the device receives regular software updates that keep it up to date with the latest security patches and improvements. [97c82b91fa3d_3]

chunks.text: Excellent phone SAMSUNG Galaxy S20 FE 5G. The phone has a long battery life which what I was I wanted,
Samsung S20 FE. The S20-FE is an amazing phone and camera, I love my S7 which is a keeper and this S20 is so many levels more impressive.
LOVING IT..... I'm Loving my new Samsung Galaxy S20 FE Phone. Great features and the camera quality is awesome...
Samsung s20 fe. It is simply great!
Samsung S20 FE. Product performs as promis3d
Galaxy S20 FE. By far the best phone we've ever had. Great photos. I doubt I'll ever figure out how to use it to it's full capabilities. Thanks Samsung.
Samsung Galaxy S20 FE. This is such a good renewed phone. No visible scratches and it looks brand new. It's very fast and takes pictures clear and bright.

Samsung's One UI provides a user-friendly interface, packed with useful features and customization options. The device also receives regular software updates, ensuring it stays up to date with the latest security patches and improvements. Overall, the Samsung Galaxy S20 FE 5G is an exceptional smartphone that offers outstanding performance, a stunning display, impressive camera capabilities, and reliable connectivity. It is a device that truly delivers on all fronts and provides an unparalleled user experience. If you're in the market for a flagship-level phone at a more accessible price point, I highly recommend considering the Samsung Galaxy S20 FE 5G.

A new phone with microSD. In 2022 it's very difficult to buy a new phone with microSD support. I bought this S20 FE to replace my S9+. It was easy to transfer all my apps and data to the new phone. Unfortunately Samsung deliberately limits the performance of external SD cards to encourage people to buy phones with larger internal storage. My SDXC card can do 91MB/s read and 59MB/s write on my laptop's card reader, but only 74MB/s read and 38MB/s write on S20 FE.

Great phone and great value for the money. I recently purchased the Samsung S20 FE, and I must say, it is truly a great value for the money, especially when compared to its competition. This smartphone offers an impressive combination of features, performance, and affordability. In terms of value for money, the Samsung S20 FE shines. Its pricing is more affordable compared to other flagship smartphones in the market, while still offering comparable features and performance. You're getting a premium smartphone experience without breaking the bank, which is a rare find in today's market. Overall, I am thoroughly impressed with the Samsung S20 FE. It combines top-notch performance, a stunning display, versatile cameras, long battery life, and all at a price that is highly competitive. If you're in the market for a flagship-level smartphone without the exorbitant price tag, the Samsung S20 FE is definitely worth considering.
